D.current_capability: Row 1, monitoring observations, and the bounded national calendar are established. PRs #20, #21 and #22 are merged. Row 2 (PR #18) supplies laboratory rows read from all 1,180 held reports and joined to monitoring observations in both directions inside the four-year reach; each row or observation left unjoined carries the cause its reading establishes. Open in reach: the CNR 68F/2024 coordinate disagreement, the UNIBA XF 35/2023 row that prints no sample identity, and the two CRSFA 849/2024 rows whose identity is printed above the table. Row 1 also holds a positional qualification for every located in-reach monitoring observation: 450,646 of 450,646 (2,200 positive), each with error_m 7.40 m against the ground in EPSG:32633. At B's 50 m, C decides 12,803 non-positive neighbours of in-reach positives inside and 56,419 outside; 27,706 stay unknown. Open: the device and capture mode per record, per-fix accuracy, re-sample links and the device before late 2024. Row 6 removal orders (PR #15): every held removal-order original is read from its own text for its case-prescription records (the stated term as printed, its anchor, the commitment, the commencement and coercive populations and the executor). Lawful dueness is the order's own reading, held to its governing A rows, to held court dispositions and to the changes held acts state about it; DDS 18/2024's withdrawal of 50 m host removal from five 2023 orders leaves theirs unknown until A records it (PR #35). Held municipal, regional and court-stated postings attach by the identity they print; the executor's albo rows naming an order, mostly aid liquidations to owners who performed the removal, are kept as leads for row 11. Each order's own mass-publicity basis is read. Every order's Art. 21-ter result is unknown: no recipient notification or commencement record is held. The Osservatorio-held facts of rows 4, 7, 8 and 11 have one binding, osservatorio-records; the removal-order caller passes supplied delivery, commencement, removal and history records to C for each recipient a record names (PR #33), and where none is supplied C's answer stays unknown and names it. Row 3 adopted geography (PR #8) is established: every consumed A area version in reach (26 of A's 29) reaches C as MetricGeometry with a local ground-error bound, and C's adopted_area_facts decides membership. A zone the act defines around the infected plants it names is built around the row 1 positives the act names, with row 1's measured error; a listed unit no named positive reaches carries its extent in the error, and a band drawn from plants is held to the units the annex lists, land the band and the annex dispute answering neither way for any place or parcel that may have part in it: within its own error plus the error of the sources drawing that land's edge, or, along the edge the land shares with the listed units, by an overlap above 1 m². Open: DDS 148/2024 is not held, so row 3 is not established for 2024-11-12 to 2024-12-18 (A's bounded unknown; search closed); the DDS 82/2026 buffer outline lies a median 20.4 km from SIT's (19.5 km before its foci were located), unexplained; where ISTAT draws part of a unit named whole (DDS 127/2022, 18/2024, 158/2024, 82/2026) the outline carries ISTAT's measured error, up to 705 m (Squinzano). Subject populations (rows 4-5) are planned on it (PR #36). PRs #14, #29 and #31 are merged; PRs #13, #16, #19, #23 and #24 are closed. No Stage D closure or source-population acceptance is implied. Row 12 vector monitoring (PR #34): the Osservatorio's 2022-2024 tables and circolari and the CNR-IPSP transmissions are read for what the consumers take. The next-season onset bound is a retrospective lateness bound (a removal after it was certainly late), available only once that onset has passed; C's ordering clock takes an exact onset and no accepted C function reads a bound until the deferred 13(1)-sub1 evaluator exists. It comes only from the season after the detection: DET 2/2024 22/04/2024 and DET 51/2026 29/05/2026 are observed with no lower bound, and DET 9/2025 and DET 20/2023 have none, their next seasons (2025, 2023) placing no adult in Annex III as read. No acquired table prints a test-result column; the vector positives are the three recited Triggiano findings, which print no window. The zone test runs on PR #8's branch until PR #8 merges.
